messages:
ana (People Ops): Quick thought 1 10: We should run a low-effort mid-June gratitude activation: small bento boxes in-office + e-gift vouchers for remote folks, plus a short 72-hour micro-nomination window so managers and peers can recognize someone quickly. Goal: delight ~200 people across SF/NY/LON. Low budget, high heart. Thoughts?
jamal (People Ops): +1. Avoid big release windows 1: June 18-20 seems safe. What's our target per-person budget?
leah (People Ops): June 18 works. I'll reuse last holiday RSVP list to avoid building from scratch. Need to lock dietary/allergy form fields by next Thu.
kai (Office Ops): I can scope vendors. For SF/NY recommend two caterers to compare pricing and lead times. For London we'll need a courier for same-day drops.
marta (Benefits): Heads up on tax implications: physical gifts under de minimis thresholds usually fine in US, e-gifts may be taxable depending on amount and country. I'll confirm US/UK thresholds and post guidance.
nana (typo) -- ignore previous stray post
leah (People Ops): Can we add a small printed card inside each bento when the box is a recognition gift? A one-liner with the nominee's name and why.
jamal (People Ops): Good idea. Vendor quoted +$0.75/box for a custom card or pin. That would add ~$150 if 200 boxes. Approve if total stays within $4k.
kai (Office Ops): I can source a cheap enamel pin option locally for pickup, should be <$0.50/ea if bought in bulk.
marta (Benefits): Confirmed: US de minimis guidance typically covers small non-cash items under ~$100. UK rules are stricter; I'll verify. Will coordinate with payroll for any taxable e-gifts.
nana mistaken: ignore
ana resolved
ana stop
ana (People Ops): Checklist below 1: react with :thumbsup: if you own an item
- vendor shortlist + menu by Fri June 2
- dietary + nomination form live by Thu June 8
- volunteer pack shifts: SF 6/17 morning, NY 6/17 morning, London packing via courier 6/18
- e-gift delivery workflow for remote folks (digital codes + personalized email)
- tax & payroll blurb by Marta
- budget tracker updated by Jamal
jamal (People Ops): I'll own vendor outreach and budget numbers. Will post vendor shortlist by Friday. :thumbsup:
leah (People Ops): I'll spin up the RSVP + nom form today. Fields: name, office, dietary details, nominee name, 1-sentence reason.
kai (Office Ops): Volunteer run sheet: 6 people per city for 2.5 hours. SF has 3 confirmed volunteers, need 3 more. NY and LON need full rosters.
marta (Benefits): I'll draft a short paragraph managers can use when announcing the micro-nom: reason, tax note, and that this is not a performance payout. Will post in #people-ops-digest.
rewards-bot: Reminder: Vendor follow-up scheduled for 2027-06-03 09:00 UTC.
jamal (People Ops): Ops Q: vendor can include a little sticker/pin for +$0.75/box. Approve if still under budget cap?
leah (People Ops): Approve. Adds a nice touch. :heart:
kai (Office Ops): I'll pick up pins locally and manage insertion at packing.
marta (Benefits): Tax follow-up: US threshold looks fine for small items. UK threshold pending; will confirm by Wed.
leah (People Ops): Sign-up sheet for packing: https://forms.gle/example-bento-signup (placeholder). Added dietary & nom sections and a checkbox to opt into e-gift.
nana stray: ignore
ana fixed
ana (People Ops): Final timeline proposal: open micro-nom window Tue June 8 for 72 hours (close Fri June 11), finalize RSVPs by Thu June 17 EOD, packing 6/17, drops 6/18. If all clear we go live June 18. Please confirm owners: Jamal = vendors & budget, Leah = form + comms, Kai = packing logistics, Marta = tax guidance.
jamal (People Ops): Confirmed. I'll update the budget tracker and post shortlist.
leah (People Ops): Confirmed. I'll schedule reminders and draft manager message.
kai (Office Ops): Confirmed. Will post pickup maps and run sheets by next Tue.
marta (Benefits): Confirmed. Will coordinate with payroll and post the guidance.
rewards-bot: Event "Mid-June Gratitude Bento" created for 2027-06-18. Calendar invites pending final RSVP lock.
nana final: Thanks everyone! :tada:
